survivors.claim: D4 calls the overlay a full-page host, but position:absolute; inset:0 on a child of an unpositioned body resolves against the initial containing block, so the host is exactly one viewport tall (900px) on a 3088px page. While marking mode is on, pointer hit-testing below the first screen reaches the mock, not the overlay: the mock's own hover and mousedown handlers fire under a drag past the fold. The click itself was not delivered (the draft element swaps the mouseup target) and the drawn region still saves at the right place, so the drawing path is intact; this is the residue of the locked CSS, kept soft because the Decision's own CSS is followed verbatim and no control is unreachable.
survivors.impact: On a long mock, dragging a box below the first screen lets the page underneath react to the mouse as if marking were off, though the box still lands where it was drawn.
survivors.evidence: Executed in headless Chrome, 1200x900, fixture with a 600px spacer and a 3088px document: after a real click on Mark area, overlay host computed pointer-events=auto, host rect h=900 while document.documentElement.scrollHeight=3088; after window.scrollTo(0,1200), document.elementFromPoint(700,130) returned BUTTON#mockbtn (the mock) and elementFromPoint(300,700) returned the mock DIV, neither inside an .nl-host; a real CDP click at (700,130) left window.__mockClicks at 0 and opened no card. The real drag (100,500)-(300,600) at scrollY=1200 painted the draft at l=100 t=500 w=200 h=100 and after Save the new box N001 rendered at the identical viewport rect with POST /add recorded. D4 quoted: mounts a full-page position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none host over the mock root.

survivors.claim: The Reply control and its textarea were removed per the disposer's binding closure, but D6 still enumerates a reply field and Reply under both statuses, and the UI section's empty-focus rule for the reply field now describes a control that does not exist. The spec text and the shipped card disagree; the deviations sidecar records the removal but the Decision was not amended.
survivors.impact: Anyone reading the spec expects a Reply button on every note card that the served page never shows.
survivors.evidence: D6 quoted: a reply field, and controls by status: open -> Reply, Resolve; addressed -> Reply, Reject, Accept. Executed: with the N-ACC card open in headless Chrome, card.querySelectorAll(textarea).length=0 and the button list is exactly Reject, Accept, and the overflow glyph; grep -n -i reply over notes-layer.browser.js finds only comment lines 15-17, 42, 357-358. Deviations sidecar fix-pass bullet records the removal and says the earlier empty-focus clause no longer applies.

survivors.claim: None of the six fixes carries a regression pin. The AC tests still drive controls with element.click() and read DOM state, which is exactly why the first pass's six defects passed a green suite; the fixed behaviours (slot-level pointer-events, page-relative box math through scroll, the phone sheet leaving inline left/top unset, the badge --c, the children-mode footnote, the row-click scroll) would all regress silently again.
survivors.impact: The next edit to this file can reintroduce any of the six shipped defects without a single test turning red.
survivors.evidence: fix-delta-2.txt lists only notes-layer.browser.js and the deviations sidecar; git diff --stat shows no tests/ change. grep -n for dispatchMouseEvent, elementFromPoint, pageYOffset, scrollTo, 640, fitted to content across tests/mocks/notes-layer-region.test.js returns no hits (the nlDrag helper dispatches synthetic MouseEvents, not CDP input). The manifest's tests leg records writes 14, rewrites 1 for the whole spec, none in this delta.

killed.claim: The note card and the undo toast are mounted inside the overlay host, which carries inline pointer-events:none whenever marking mode is off; neither the card nor the toast overrides it, so every card control and the toast Undo button cannot be reached by a real pointer.
killed.evidence: Fix sets pointer-events:auto on cardSlot and toastSlot (lines 208-209). Executed in headless Chrome 1200x900 with real CDP Input.dispatchMouseEvent (mouseMoved, mousePressed, mouseReleased), marking off: click at the box centre (200,700) opened the card; document.elementFromPoint at the Accept centre (645.6,724.7) resolved through the overlay host's shadowRoot to BUTTON.nl-btn primary; Reject at (570.1,724.7) to BUTTON.nl-btn; the overflow glyph to BUTTON.nl-btn; after a real click on it the Withdraw menu item hit-tests to a BUTTON; after a real click on Reject the reason field hit-tests to TEXTAREA and is focused. Real click on Accept produced the toast (text ResolvedUndo, computed position fixed); elementFromPoint at the Undo centre (625.6,853.5) resolved to the toast BUTTON; a real click on it cleared the toast, and after 5.6s window.__posts was empty and the box data-status stayed addressed. Composer path: after a real drag the textarea hit-tests to TEXTAREA and is focused, Save note hit-tests to BUTTON.nl-btn primary, and a real click on it POSTed /add.

killed.claim: regionBadge() never sets the per-badge --c custom property, so outside a .nl-region box the pill renders transparent with near-white text.
killed.evidence: Fix adds badge.style.setProperty(--c, colorFor(status)) at line 244. Executed: strip row badge for N-ACC computed background rgb(217, 119, 6), color rgb(250, 250, 250), inline --c=var(--v-warn), text N-ACC; the card header badge computed background rgb(217, 119, 6) and color rgb(250, 250, 250).

killed.claim: The build mounts the overlay host position:fixed over the viewport and repaints only on resize and state click, so on any mock taller than the viewport the boxes stay at their first-paint coordinates while the page scrolls underneath.
killed.evidence: Fix mounts the host position:absolute; inset:0 (line 212) and adds pageXOffset/pageYOffset to box (lines 260-261, 275-276), card (lines 319-323, 481-489) and draft (lines 523-524) placement. Executed, 600px spacer above the root: unscrolled box rect top=600 = anchor top=600; after window.scrollTo(0,400) and 400ms, scrollY=400, box top=200, anchor top=200, drift=0; a real click on the box at (200,300) then opened the card at left=412 top=200, i.e. box.right+12 and box.top, besideBox=true. Row-click scroll from scrollY=2321 to 250 re-painted the box at 350..550 with the card at left=412 top=350, still beside it.

killed.claim: The card Reply control accepts typed text and, on click, clears the textarea and posts nothing.
killed.evidence: Removed rather than routed, per the disposer's closure. Executed with the N-ACC card open: card.querySelectorAll(textarea).length=0; button texts are exactly Reject, Accept and the overflow glyph; no button matches /Reply/. grep -n -i reply across notes-layer.browser.js returns only comment lines (15-17, 42, 357-358); grep -rn -i reply across tests/mocks/notes-layer-region.test.js, notes-region-store.test.js and notes-layer-navigation.test.js matches only the reply: null data field on note fixtures, which is the store schema, not the removed control. Nothing dangles: the card row still receives Resolve or Reject/Accept and the overflow menu, and the composer's own textarea (line 454) is untouched.

killed.claim: The layer sets position/left/top inline on the card, and inline declarations beat the viewer.css max-width:640px rule, so at 390px the card is a 325px floating box positioned beside the box, not a sheet.
killed.evidence: Fix returns early from cardPosition() under matchMedia(max-width:640px) (line 318) and guards the composer's placement the same way (line 481); card.style.position is no longer written anywhere. Executed at setViewport(390,844): after a real click on the box, card computed position=fixed, inline left and top both empty, rect left=0 right=375 bottom=829 (the 15px difference on each axis is the headless scrollbars: innerWidth=390 with a vertical bar, and the page is wider than 390 so a horizontal bar sits at the bottom), width 375 = the full layout viewport; after window.scrollBy(0,200) the rect was unchanged; the Accept button hit-tests to BUTTON.nl-btn primary at 390px.

killed.claim: D8 promises two strip behaviours the build never implements: the children-mode footnote and clicking a row scrolls to the box.
killed.evidence: Fix adds regionInfo() carrying mode (lines 229-237), the footnote at line 646, and scrollIntoView before openNoteCard at lines 651-656. Executed with the strip filter switched to All by a real click: the N-FIT row (region whose stored aspect 4 mismatches the live 1:1 element and touched=[0], NotesAnchor.resolve mode=children) renders small text JJ · fitted to content on this size, while N-ACC and N-FAR (exact) read JJ. Real click on the N-ACC row while the strip was in view at scrollY=2321 (box at viewport top -1721): scrollY became 250, box rect 350..550 (centred in 900), card open beside it. Real click on the N-FAR row also opened its card and added .sel to its box.

killed.claim: Switching the host to position:absolute breaks drawing on a scrolled page (draft rectangle or saved box offset by the scroll amount).
killed.evidence: Executed at scrollY=1200 with real CDP mouse events: mousePressed at (100,500), mouseMoved to (300,600): the .nl-draft rect read l=100 t=500 w=200 h=100 in viewport coordinates, under the pointer; after mouseReleased the composer opened with its textarea focused; typing via Input.insertText and a real click on Save note POSTed /add, and the new box N001 painted at l=100 t=500 w=200 h=100, the same viewport rect as the drag.
